text: dsh-intelligence-ui 是 DSH Web 聊天的生成式界面插件：它注册助手回复渲染器，支持 OpenUI 围栏，并可把结构化 Markdown 表格、指标和步骤转为卡片、表格或图表。普通文字仍按 Markdown 显示。组件库还包括地图、代码差异和交互控件，并跟随 DSH 浅色与深色主题。适合希望在聊天中清晰展示报告和数据的用户。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.0 或以上且支持插件 bundle；无需额外 API Key。

dsh-intelligence-ui renders OpenUI in DSH Web chat. It displays native fences and converts Markdown tables, metrics, and steps into visual components; prose stays Markdown. Components include charts, maps, code diffs, and controls. Requires DSH 0.2.1+ with plugin bundles; no API key is needed.
想让聊天回答里的数据表和指标变成更容易浏览的界面。
DSH 能不能把 OpenUI 代码块直接显示成卡片和图表？
我希望报告里的表格、步骤和关键数字自动排版成视觉组件。
让助手在回答中插入可交互的图表、表格或控件。
普通文字继续用 Markdown，只有结构化内容才转换成界面。
想在 DSH 聊天里用统一的浅色和深色主题展示内容。
Can DSH turn structured Markdown tables and metrics into readable visuals?
I want OpenUI blocks in assistant replies to render as interactive components.
dsh-intelligence-ui 的功能「原生 OpenUI 围栏」：回复中的 ```openui 程序会被解析、求值并渲染为组件；围栏外的内容仍按 Markdown 显示，适合在解释文字中嵌入界面。
dsh-intelligence-ui 的功能「结构化 Markdown 转界面」：定稿回复达到视觉呈现条件时，编译器可将表格、指标列表、键值列表和步骤转换为表格、统计卡片、图表或步骤组件；纯文本继续走 Markdown。
dsh-intelligence-ui 的功能「丰富的界面组件」：运行时装配布局、文本、文件差异、数据、图表、地图、流程和控件组件，供 OpenUI 程序组合出报告、可视化和交互式内容。
dsh-intelligence-ui 的功能「原生文字回退」：无法转换或不适合可视化的回复继续交给宿主 Markdown 渲染器；渲染组件出错时使用局部提示，避免整个消息区域消失。
使用前须知：可将 localStorage 键 dsh-intelligence-ui:disable-auto 设为 1 关闭 Markdown 自动编译；OpenUI 围栏仍可用。（src/client.jsx:26-34）

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Intelligence UI for DeepSeek Harness：**Chat replies that render as interfaces, not walls of Markdown.**

A plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that upgrades the assistant-message renderer:
model-authored [OpenUI Lang](https://github.com/thesysdev/openui) fences render as cards, tables,
charts and diagrams in place, while structured Markdown is automatically compiled into the same
visual language. Plain text stays plain text.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Why not plain Markdown?：Markdown is excellent for prose but poor at structure: KPI comparisons turn into walls of text,
tables lose hierarchy on mobile, and trends are invisible. Intelligence UI keeps Markdown for the
parts that are prose and upgrades the rest:

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Why not plain Markdown?：- **Structure where it matters** — metrics, comparisons, timelines, steps, trees, charts and code
  changes render in their natural form instead of ASCII tables.
- **Fast to read** — compact previews, aligned numbers, semantic status colours, one accent per
  screen.
- **Safe by construction** — a bad program never breaks the message; invalid input degrades to a
  local notice or plain text.
- **No new app, no build** — it ships as one directory bundle inside the chat you already use.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · What it does：An assistant reply can mix prose and interface blocks. The plugin intercepts the
`assistant-step` renderer (priority −20) and runs a three-mode pipeline:

dsh-intelligence-ui README · What it does：| Reply shape       | Trigger                                                   | Rendering                                                           |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Native fence**  | a ` ```openui ` program in the reply                      | parse → evaluate → render components in place (highest fidelity)    |
| **Auto-compiled** | no fence, but Markdown tables / KPI lists / ordered steps | the client compiler turns them into cards, charts and search tables |
| **Plain text**    | everything else                                           | the host Markdown renderer, unchanged                               |

dsh-intelligence-ui README · What it does：Text outside a fence stays Markdown, so one reply can be: explanation → chart → caveat.openui
root = Stack([kpis, chart, note], "column", 16)
kpis = Grid([a, b], 2, 12, 150)
a = StatCard("Revenue", "¥84,300", "+12.6%", "up", null, "gross, tax included", "brand")
b = StatCard("Refund rate", "1.2%", "-0.3%", "down", null, "below the 2% guardrail", "warning")
chart = Chart("Last 7 days", "area", [{name: "Revenue", values: [82, 94, 110, 129, 105, 138, 152]}], [], ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], 220)
note = Callout("Takeaway", "Revenue grew three weeks in a row; shift budget toward the fastest channel.", "success")
```

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Features：- **44 components** — primitives, layout, containers, text, data (metrics/tables/timeline/steps),
  charts (bar/line/area, donut, sparkline, heatmap), a schematic world map, code/diff/file panels,
  tree and graph views with playback, and interactive controls.
- **Theme-native design system** — every colour, radius and type step is a host theme token;
  light/dark follow automatically, with zero hard-coded colours (enforced by tests). Data uses the
  host business-blue accent; status text keeps accessible contrast in both themes.
- **Reply compiler** — a zero-dependency, deterministic Markdown → OpenUI compiler; pathological
  input safely falls back to plain Markdown.
- **Built for real model output** — positional/named/colon arguments, bare child elements,
  Python/JS literals, enum synonyms and programs written as plain code blocks are recovered;
  invalid props degrade to a local notice instead of breaking the message.
- **Streaming-safe** — unfinished fences render while the model is still writing; the final frame
  keeps the same component instances.
- **Compact by default** — charts, maps, tables and long code render compact with an in-p

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Requirements：> `engines.dsh` refers to the host's plugin-bundle API version; check the DSH build notes for the
> exact minimum.

The plugin renders against the host's `--dsw-*` theme tokens and platform modules
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*`). Those are supplied by the host; nothing needs to be installed
globally.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Quickstart：1. **Install DeepSeek Harness** — download the desktop app from
   [deepseek.com/harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/). AI features need a configured model in
   DSH.
2. **Get the plugin** — `git clone https://github.com/MarkYangKp/dsh-intelligence-ui.git`
   (no build step: `lib/client.js` is committed).
3. **Install the directory as a bundle** — open DSH's plugin manager and install this repository as
   a plugin bundle (choose the install-from-directory / bundle option and point it at the repository
   root). Menu labels vary slightly between DSH versions.
4. **Restart DSH** and open a chat. The browser console should show
   `[dsh-intelligence-ui/1.1.1]`.
5. **Paste the example below** into a message (as-is, no extra prompt needed) and send it.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Quickstart：If step 3 is unavailable in your DSH build, that build does not expose plugin bundles and cannot
load this plugin; upgrade DSH or use a build with bundle support.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Design system：The visual language is "Precision Editorial": host ink typography, a single business-blue accent
for data, hairline structure and layered surfaces. All tokens live in
[`src/ui/theme.js`](src/ui/theme.js); rationale, type scale and per-component guidance are in
[docs/design.md](docs/design.md).

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Design system：A headless-Chrome design gate measures computed styles (no gradients, no static shadows, no
uppercase labels, no horizontal overflow, bounded type scale, WCAG AA text contrast — 4.5:1 for
normal text, 3:1 for large text, bounded accent hues) across light/dark × 920/390.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Accessibility：- Design gates enforce WCAG AA contrast in both themes, keyboard focus for interactive controls,
  `prefers-reduced-motion`, and no horizontal overflow at 390px.
- Components use semantic HTML (headings, tables, lists, buttons) and `aria-*` labels where needed;
  charts carry text labels for series, axes and values.
- Known gaps: SVG charts are not yet exposed as an accessible data table, and the schematic map is
  not keyboard-navigable. Contributions welcome.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · How it works：````
assistant-step text block
  ├─ ```openui fence ─► parse → evaluate → render components (text outside stays Markdown)
  ├─ no fence, settled ─► Markdown compiler → OpenUI program → render
  └─ otherwise ─► host Markdown renderer
````

dsh-intelligence-ui README · How it works：The repository contains both halves of the plugin: a host half that injects prompt modules
(`index.js`) and a browser half that registers the renderer (`src/` → `lib/client.js`). Component
implementations are split into focused modules under `src/ui/`; the tolerant binding layer and
render pipeline live in `src/openui-runtime.jsx`. Isolation boundaries, resource budgets, streaming
identity and clipboard/timer cleanup are described in [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build            # → lib/client.js (committed; CI checks it is up to date)
pnpm test             # build + unit/browser suites (310 checks; browser suites skip without Chrome)
pnpm test:unit        # the same suites without browser tests (no Chrome needed)

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Development：Test suites cover a synthetic 56-program corpus, 63 adversarial inputs, the Markdown compiler,
theme-token fidelity, prompt modules, bundle budget/schema fingerprint, chart SSR, and real-browser
lifecycle/heap checks. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for prerequisites and PR
expectations.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Development：The gallery and design gate prefer a local snapshot of the host theme. Generate one with
`node scripts/extract-theme.mjs` (optional; it falls back to an original approximation in
`test/fixtures/theme-fallback.css`).

Generated artefacts in this repository: `lib/client.js` (the shipped bundle) and
`docs/gallery*` / `docs/hero.png` (rendered by `pnpm shot`). Do not edit them by hand; CI verifies
the bundle is in sync with `src/`.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Privacy & telemetry：The plugin itself has **no analytics, no telemetry and makes no network requests**. Installing the
development dependencies does not send telemetry either: the upstream `@openuidev/lang-core`
install hook is explicitly denied in this repository's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (see
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Remote images
that a user or model references through the `Image` component are loaded by the host, like any other
chat image. The bundled upstream `@openuidev/lang-core` telemetry path is disabled unless the host
explicitly sets `OPENUI_RUNTIME_TELEMETRY_ENABLED`; the browser runtime never enables it (the
inert upstream code is documented in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Clipboard access happens only
through user-initiated copy buttons.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Language support：The component library and host API are locale-neutral. The injected prompt modules, example
programs and gallery content are currently written in **Chinese**, the primary language of the
first release; an English prompt set is on the roadmap. UI chrome rendered by the plugin itself is
minimal and language-neutral; number and date formatting comes from the content.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · Limitations：- The map is schematic: an equirectangular projection with a simplified world outline — suitable
  for distributions and routes, not for navigation.
- On 390px screens, tree/diagram figures scale to fit (labels get small) instead of scrolling.
- Expand state is per message, not persisted across replies.
- Auto-compilation only recognises clear structures; prose numbers are not turned into charts.
- The tolerance layer fixes syntax, not semantics: swapped values cannot be detected.
- Rendering depends on host internals (renderer slot, theme tokens, platform module table); a host
  upgrade may require plugin changes.

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 为什么不只用 Markdown？：Markdown 适合散文，不适合结构：KPI 对比会变成文字墙，表格在窄屏上丢掉层次，趋势完全看不见。
Intelligence UI 把该用文字的部分留给 Markdown，其余部分升级成界面：

- **结构用在刀刃上**：指标、对比、时间线、步骤、树、图表、代码改动按它们本来的形态呈现，而不是
  ASCII 表格。
- **读得更快**：紧凑预览、数字右对齐、语义状态色、一屏只保留一个点缀色。
- **天生安全**：坏掉的程序不会打断整条消息；非法输入只降级为局部提示或纯文字。
- **不换应用、不用构建**：作为单个目录 bundle 装进你正在用的聊天窗口。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 它做什么：| 回复形态     | 触发条件                                           | 渲染方式                                 |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| **原生围栏** | 回复里有 ` ```openui ` 程序                        | 解析 → 求值 → 原地渲染组件（保真度最高） |
| **自动编译** | 没有围栏，但含 Markdown 表格 / KPI 列表 / 有序步骤 | 客户端编译器升级成卡片、图表、搜索表格   |
| **纯文字**   | 其它情况                                           | 官方 Markdown 渲染，原样不动             |

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 它做什么：围栏外的文字照常按 Markdown 渲染，所以一条回复可以是「说明 → 图表 → 补充说明」。openui
root = Stack([kpis, chart, note], "column", 16)
kpis = Grid([a, b], 2, 12, 150)
a = StatCard("本周收入", "¥84,300", "+12.6%", "up", null, "含税 GMV", "brand")
b = StatCard("退款率", "1.2%", "-0.3%", "down", null, "低于 2% 警戒线", "warning")
chart = Chart("近七日", "area", [{name: "收入", values: [82, 94, 110, 129, 105, 138, 152]}], [], ["一", "二", "三", "四", "五", "六", "日"], 220)
note = Callout("结论", "收入连续三周环比正增长，建议把预算向增速最快的渠道倾斜。", "success")
```

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 特性：- **44 个组件**：原语、布局、容器、文本、数据（指标/表格/时间线/步骤）、图表（柱线面积、
  环形、迷你图、热力）、示意级世界地图、代码/差异/文件树、可播放的树与图，以及交互控件。
- **主题原生设计系统**：颜色、圆角、字号全部来自宿主主题 token，明暗主题自动跟随，零硬编码颜色
  （有测试把关）；数据使用宿主业务蓝点缀色，状态文字在明暗主题下都保持可读对比度。
- **回复编译器**：零依赖、确定性的 Markdown → OpenUI 编译器；病态输入安全退回纯文字。
- **为真实模型输出而建**：位置/命名/冒号参数、裸子元素、Python/JS 字面量、枚举同义词、
  写在普通代码块里的程序都能救回；字段不合法只降级为局部提示，不打断整条消息。
- **流式安全**：未闭合围栏边生成边渲染；定稿不会重挂载控件实例。
- **默认紧凑**：图表、地图、表格、长代码默认收紧，点「展开」原地放大。
- **提示词架构**：宿主每轮注入「呈现策略 + 组件能力」两个模块，让模型知道*什么时候*、*怎么*用界面。

1. **安装 DeepSeek Harness** —— 从 [deepseek.com/harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) 下载桌面
   应用，并在 DSH 中配置好可用模型。
2. **获取插件** —— `git clone https://github.com/MarkYangKp/dsh-intelligence-ui.git`
   （无需构建：`lib/client.js` 已进仓）。
3. **把目录装成 bundle** —— 打开 DSH 插件管理器，选择「从本地目录安装 / install bundle」，指向仓库
   根目录。不同 DSH 版本菜单措辞略有差异。
4. **重启 DSH** 并打开聊天窗口；浏览器控制台应出现 `[dsh-intelligence-ui/1.1.1]`。
5. **把下面的示例原样粘贴**到输入框发送，即可看到界面。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 使用：正常写 Markdown，在需要界面的位置插入围栏：

````markdown
故障复盘：

```openui
root = Stack([hd, tl, ok], "column", 16)
hd = Heading("故障复盘", 2)
tl = Timeline([{"title": "14:02 告警", "description": "错误率超过 15%", "time": "14:02", "variant": "error"}, {"title": "14:26 回滚完成", "description": "错误率回落至 0.4%", "time": "14:26", "variant": "success"}])
ok = Callout("下一步", "给索引任务补上连接池上限。", "info")
```
````

不写围栏也可以——结构化 Markdown 会被自动升级。两条路径共用同一套
`parse → evaluate → render` 管线。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 设计系统：「Precision Editorial」：宿主墨色排版 + 单一业务蓝点缀 + 发丝线结构 + 分层表面。
token 全部在 [`src/ui/theme.js`](src/ui/theme.js)，动机、字号阶梯与逐组件规范见
[docs/design.md](docs/design.md)。

无头 Chrome 设计门禁基于计算样式测量：无渐变、静止元素无阴影、无大写标签、无横向溢出、
字号档位受控、文字对比度满足 WCAG AA（正文 4.5:1、大字 3:1）、强调色色相受控；覆盖明暗 ×
920/390。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 无障碍：- 设计门禁在明暗主题下强制 WCAG AA 对比度、交互控件的键盘焦点、`prefers-reduced-motion`，
  并检查 390px 下无横向溢出。
- 组件使用语义化 HTML（标题、表格、列表、按钮），必要时补 `aria-*`；图表带有系列、坐标轴与
  数值的文字标签。
- 已知缺口：SVG 图表暂未提供可访问的数据表视图；示意地图不支持键盘导航。欢迎贡献。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 工作原理：````
assistant-step 文本块
  ├─ ```openui 围栏 ─► 解析 → 求值 → 渲染组件（围栏外文字仍按 Markdown）
  ├─ 无围栏且定稿 ─► Markdown 编译器 → OpenUI 程序 → 渲染
  └─ 其它 ─► 官方 Markdown 渲染
````

仓库包含插件的两半：宿主半边注入提示模块（`index.js`），浏览器半边注册渲染器
（`src/` → `lib/client.js`）。组件实现拆分在 `src/ui/` 下，容错绑定层与渲染管线在
`src/openui-runtime.jsx`；隔离边界、资源预算、流式身份保持、复制/定时器清理见
[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 开发：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build            # → lib/client.js（已进仓，CI 会检查是否与源码同步）
pnpm test             # 构建 + 单元/浏览器套件（310 项）
pnpm test:unit        # 不含浏览器测试的同一套件（无需 Chrome）

测试覆盖：56 段合成回归语料、63 项对抗输入、Markdown 编译器、主题 token 保真、提示词模块、
bundle 体积/schema 指纹、图表 SSR、真实浏览器生命周期与堆检查。开发环境与 PR 约定见
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

画廊与设计门禁优先使用本地宿主主题快照（`node scripts/extract-theme.mjs` 可选生成）；
没有时使用自写近似主题 `test/fixtures/theme-fallback.css`。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 开发：仓库里的生成物：`lib/client.js`（随仓库分发的客户端 bundle）与 `docs/gallery*` /
`docs/hero.png`（由 `pnpm shot` 渲染）。不要手改这些文件；CI 会校验 bundle 与 `src/` 同步。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 隐私与遥测：插件本身**没有任何分析、遥测，也不发网络请求**。安装开发依赖同样不发送遥测：上游
`@openuidev/lang-core` 的安装钩子已在本仓库 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中显式拒绝（见
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)）。用户或模型通过 `Image` 组件引用的远程图片
由宿主加载（与普通聊天图片一致）。打包进 bundle 的上游 `@openuidev/lang-core` 遥测仅在宿主显式
设置 `OPENUI_RUNTIME_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` 时启用，浏览器运行时不会启用（不可达的上游代码已在
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 说明）。剪贴板只在用户点击复制按钮时写入。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 语言支持：组件库与宿主 API 与语言无关。注入的提示词模块、示例程序与画廊内容目前为**中文**（首个版本的
主要语言）；英文提示词集在路线图中。插件自身渲染的 UI 文案极少且中性；数字与日期格式来自内容。

dsh-intelligence-ui README · 已知限制：- 地图是示意级的（等距圆柱投影 + 简化世界轮廓）：适合分布与路径，不适合导航。
- 390px 宽度下树/图按比例缩放（标签会变小），而不是横向滚动。
- 展开状态按消息独立，不跨回复记忆。
- 自动编译只识别明确结构；散文中的数字不会变成图表。
- 容错层只修语法，不修语义：数据张冠李戴无法发现。
- 渲染依赖宿主内部（渲染座位、主题 token、平台模块表），宿主升级可能需要插件适配。
